clauses.reason: Two scopes: item 1 (offsets 2389-2904) and item 2 (offsets 2905-2967) of the held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_10739.txt, 22 FR 9205: signed 1957-11-15 (the same Federal Register page also prints EO 10738, a separate order with its own claim). Item 1 further amends section 9 of Executive Order 10152 (as amended by Executive Order 10618) by adding a subsection (h) defining duty as human test subject in thermal stress experiments as duty performed by members exposed as human thermal experimental subjects in thermal stress experiments conducted under the supervision of a laboratory designated by the Secretary concerned. Item 2 states that the amendment is effective as of 1957-09-01, a retroactive effective-date direction that applies the same rule from that date and has no separate end. EO 11120 (signed 1963-10-02) amended section 9 by striking subsections (c), (d) and (g) and amending subsection (e) (offset 2729 of its held text), so subsection (h) was not changed by it; EO 11157 section 109(e), at offsets 13311-13600 of its held text, restates the same definition. No sunset or condition ends either item. This scope is item 1, the added subsection (h) (offsets 2389-2904).

research_rationale:
EO 10739 is a strike-and-insert or addition amendment of a pay-and-allowance regulation order. Under the strike-and-insert ruling (owner ruling 2026-10-21, option B) its clauses continue, as amended, until the parent order ends. The first held end is the express revocation by EO 11157 section 502 (signed 1964-06-22, no effective-date wording), which names this order and its parent. The 1962 title 37 recodification is disclosed as an unnamed earlier candidate that I read as restating without substantive change (Public Law 87-649 section 12). Searches: no U.S. Code or eCFR hit for this order; the OFR disposition-note search lists the chain events recorded in the dossier.
